The API SLA risk calculator successfully passed all validation tests with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating robust weighted-risk logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.70 across one trial with zero exceptions. Pytest 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite with a duration of 0.268s. While the core logic is reusable, future iterations should re-check edge case assumptions in the weighted-risk formula to ensure the judge_reward can be further optimized.
